categories.main_business_segments: Asahi Diamond Industrial Co., Ltd. operates a single business segment focused on the manufacturing and sales of diamond tools, including CBN tools and grinding wheels. Its products primarily serve the electronics and semiconductor, transportation equipment, machinery, and stone/construction industries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced diamond and CBN tool technologies, including electroplated wires, vitrified and resin bonds, and high-precision grinding and slicing methods. It emphasizes R&D in next-generation ultra-fine wheels, high-performance wire saws, and eco-friendly, high-durability products for difficult-to-machine materials such as SiC and GaN.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include manufacturers in the electronics and semiconductor sectors (notably for Si, SiC, and compound semiconductors), automotive and transportation equipment makers, machinery and industrial equipment producers, and the stone/construction industry. The company also supplies universities, research institutions, and the ceramics and jewelry sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: Asahi Diamond operates globally, with major sales in Japan, Asia/Oceania (including Taiwan, China, Southeast Asia, India, and Australia), Europe, and North America. The company has manufacturing and sales subsidiaries in these regions, with approximately half of its consolidated sales generated overseas.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company is positioned midstream to downstream in the supply chain, supplying finished diamond tools and related products directly to manufacturers and end-users in various industries. It sources raw materials such as natural and synthetic diamonds, metals, and resins from upstream suppliers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include strengthening its position as a global niche top manufacturer, focusing on high-value-added tools for the electronics and semiconductor industries, and accelerating development of next-generation products (e.g., ultra-fine wheels, eco-friendly wires). The company invests in process innovation, digitalization, sustainability (GHG reduction, resource efficiency), and talent development to support long-term growth.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of diamond tools and related products on a per-order basis, with some products made to order and others sold from inventory. The company also receives income from equipment leasing, technical services, and, to a lesser extent, dividends from strategic equity holdings.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Asahi Diamond faces competition from both domestic and international diamond tool manufacturers, with competition based on technology, quality, delivery, and price. The company positions itself as a high-quality, reliable supplier with strong technical service and aims to be a global niche leader, especially in the electronics and semiconductor tool segment.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending March 2025, consolidated net sales were ¥41.0 billion, with operating profit of ¥2.3 billion and net profit attributable to parent shareholders of ¥2.5 billion. The company has over 2,000 employees, maintains a high equity ratio (80.7%), and has shown steady revenue and profit growth in recent years, particularly in the electronics/semiconductor and transportation sectors.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Asahi Diamond emphasizes the superior durability, precision, and efficiency of its diamond tools, enabling customers to achieve higher productivity, energy/resource savings, and reliable processing of advanced materials. Its unique value lies in its ability to deliver customized, high-performance solutions for challenging applications, backed by robust R&D and global support.
